messages:
eng_oncall_bot: incident-bot detected sustained GPU memory pressure on prod-eu-1 cluster node gpu-12. metric=GPU_MEM_USED_PCT(98%) threshold=95% duration=3m. paging via PagerDuty (PD123456).

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD123456 created and triggered to @eng-oncall. Severity: SEV2. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD123456 (auto-message)

alex_m: taking this — pinging in here so it's tracked. I'm on VPN, will ssh into node.

samira: acked on PD. on standby if you want me to run kubectl. :thumbsup:

alex_m: quick checks: `ssh gpu-12` -> `nvidia-smi` shows one process using 98% on GPU0 (model-server v2.3). PID 4218. container: redwood/model-server:prod-2026-03. memory reserved looks normal but there's a sudden spike.

jordan_r: any recent deploys? logs?

alex_m: checking deploys... none in last 30m according to deploy-bot. pulling stdout for that container:
```
[2026-03-14T10:07:12Z] Starting inference loop
[2026-03-14T10:08:01Z] Batch size 64 allocated, kv-cache growth observed
[2026-03-14T10:08:59Z] CUDA allocation failed: out of memory
[2026-03-14T10:09:00Z] Fallback triggered, retrying with smaller batch
[2026-03-14T10:09:05Z] Repeated allocations, memory pressure rising
```

alex_m: looks like a workload with large batch allocations triggered a leak or unbounded cache growth. Latency alerts also spiking.

samira: customers impacted? telemetry?

alex_m: quick check on routes: two heavy routes show 5s p95 -> 20s p95 and a small number of 503s. Using console: affected customers = 2 (enterprise team A, internal sandbox B) — non-wide customer impact but user-facing for those teams.

jordan_r: mitigation idea: cordon gpu-12, drain model pods with graceful timeout 30s, and restart model-server with env override MODEL_MAX_BATCH=16. We can also evict the runaway container.

alex_m: doing cordon+drain now. commands: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-12 --context=prod-eu-1` then `kubectl drain node/gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`

eng_oncall_bot: action scheduled: cordon node/gpu-12 (initiated by alex_m).

samira: running drain... status: pods evicted, model-server pods rescheduled to gpu-07 and gpu-09.

alex_m: evicted PID 4218 and forced container kill. Restarting model-server with batch cap env. Applying patch: `kubectl set env deployment/model-server MODEL_MAX_BATCH=16 -n inference`

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD123456 acknowledged by alex_m at 2026-03-14T10:10:05Z.

alex_m: after restart, nvidia-smi shows GPU utilization back to normal on gpu-12 (20-30%), and rescheduled pods booting on gpu-07/gpu-09. latency trending down. No new OOMs in logs for 4m.

priya_k: nice work. any follow-up to avoid recurrence?

jordan_r: probable root cause: a recent model config allowed dynamic batch growth combined with kv-cache retention for long-lived sessions. short-term mitigation is MODEL_MAX_BATCH cap and enabling KV_CACHE_TRIM_INTERVAL=60s. Long-term: add OOM-resistant fallback in runtime (reject large batches earlier) and add a circuit-breaker rule in router to limit simultaneous large-batch requests per node.

alex_m: creating post-incident ticket and runbook update now. Will include commands used, links to logs, and suggested config changes.

samira: customer comms: ops will DM enterprise team A and sandbox B to let them know we had transient degradation, mitigated, and we are updating runbook. Priya, can you own the comms?

priya_k: on it, will draft message and share.

eng_oncall_bot: Incident PD123456 severity remains SEV2. Current status: mitigated (node drained, pods rescheduled, env caps applied). Monitoring for 30m.

alex_m: handing off to jordan_r for monitoring window and post-incident actions. jordan_r, please take the PD once alex clears.

jordan_r: taking over monitoring. will escalate if anything else pops. PD ack transferred.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD123456 reassigned to jordan_r.

alex_m: notes to include in ticket: commands executed, nvidia-smi snippets, container logs, model-server image tag, applied envs (MODEL_MAX_BATCH=16, KV_CACHE_TRIM_INTERVAL=60), node cordoned/drained, customer impact (2 customers, short spike, ~10min impact window), next steps (runtime circuit-breaker, longer-term perf test for batch growth).

priya_k: drafted comms and queued with legal review.

jordan_r: will follow up with a postmortem doc after monitoring window. tagging: eng-runtime, eng-oncall, product-ops.

eng_oncall_bot: Reminder: create postmortem link and add to incident PD123456 when ready.

samira: thanks team. :clap:
